prompt: Create a new 3:2 landscape editorial illustration for Sentit, a Catalan school listening worksheet. Reference image is a character identity/style reference, not an edit target. Keep Mar exactly recognizable: adult woman with dark brown low ponytail, olive blazer, cream shirt, charcoal trousers. Soft watercolor and colored-pencil storybook drawing on warm ivory paper, quiet natural light, muted sage and earth colors. One single scene, no panels or lettering. Mar is standing in three-quarter view recording a local radio report with a handheld microphone, near a parked small mobile-library bus with CLOSED doors in an indistinct public outdoor space. A very subtle book pictogram on the bus is fine, but no readable words. Make this scene specific through the bus and reporting gesture. Do NOT depict children, teachers, a library worker, lending/returning books, gym entrances, any identifiable parking location, clocks, dates, schedules, signs, or specific books. No graphic showing answers. No text, watermark or border.
alt: La Mar prepara una crònica amb el micròfon, prop d’un vehicle de biblioteca estacionat.
notes: Il·lustració contextual pròpia; els models fixen la identitat dels recurrents. Revisió independent abans de publicar. Conversió a WebP, sense retoc del contingut.
